Lemma
[The flat map is a bijection]

↗ def:flat-map ↗ def:riemannian-metric

Let $(M,g)$ be a finite-dimensional Riemannian manifold and $p\in M$. Then $\flat \colon T_pM\to T_p^*M$ is bijective.

Proof

↗ def:flat-map ↗ def:riemannian-metric \sketch The Riesz representation theorem identifies the finite-dimensional inner product space $T_pM$ isometrically with its dual by $v\mapsto g_p(v,\cdot )$, which is the flat map.

□
